content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Indianapolis

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your educational background and years of direct project experience. Granite PM Academy can help you verify eligibility before enrollment, ensuring you meet all prerequisites for certification.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our Indianapolis-based trainers deliver the PMI-required formal education over a structured schedule, covering the PMBOK Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world application. You'll earn your completion certificate upon finishing all contact hours.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your official application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the online application portal and answer questions about required documentation and timelines.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation materials, practice tests, and study schedules. Our instructors and support team help you build confidence in high-risk content areas. When you're ready, schedule your exam at a PMI-authorized testing center and sit for the computer-based PMP assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the standard three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through approved learning activities, volunteer work, and professional contributions. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training and resources to help you sustain and grow your professional standing.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
